idea-plugin.name: Brand Bar
idea-plugin.description:
Brand Bar is an original, clean-room, MIT-licensed progress-bar plugin for IntelliJ-based JetBrains IDEs.

Fork the repository and replace only the files under src/main/resources/brand/ (runner artwork, optional reverse runner, trail tile or colors, and theme.json) to ship a company-skinned progress bar without modifying Kotlin code.

JetBrains and IntelliJ are trademarks of JetBrains s.r.o. This project is not affiliated with JetBrains.
idea-plugin.change-notes: • 0.1.0 — Brandable determinate and indeterminate ProgressBarUI driven entirely by src/main/resources/brand/, with JBUI HiDPI scaling, unit tests, and headless CI screenshot rendering.
